description: This file defines the Tracker class for the SuiteCRM project, extending SugarBean. It manages tracking user activities, retrieving recently viewed items, managing visibility of tracked items, and logging page visits. It also includes class properties related to database table details and access control.

classes.name: Tracker
classes.description: A class extending SugarBean to handle tracking user activities, recent items, visibility, and page logging within SuiteCRM.

methods.name: get_recently_viewed
methods.description: Retrieves the most recently viewed items for a given user, optionally filtered by modules.

methods.name: makeInvisibleForAll
methods.description: Sets the visibility of all items with a given item_id to invisible (0).

methods.name: logPage
methods.description: Logs the time spent on a page, using session timestamps.

methods.name: bean_implements
methods.description: Overrides the method to support ACL roles, returns false.
